title: A short exact sequence of coherent formal modules is levelwise right exact, and the kernel levels are quotients of levelwise kernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space) and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, and let $0\to(\mathcal G_n)\xrightarrow{\beta}(\mathcal F_n)\xrightarrow{\alpha}(\mathcal H_n)\to0$ be a short exact sequence in the abelian category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian], with components $\beta_n:\mathcal G_n\to\mathcal F_n$ and $\alpha_n:\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal H_n$. Then: (a) for every $n\ge1$ the sequence $\mathcal G_n\xrightarrow{\beta_n}\mathcal F_n\xrightarrow{\alpha_n}\mathcal H_n\to0$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is exact in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (exact at $\mathcal F_n$, and $\alpha_n$ surjective); (b) for every $n\ge1$ there are an integer $m\ge n$ and a surjective $\mathcal O_X$-linear map from the $\mathcal O_X$-module $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_m)\subseteq\mathcal F_m$ onto $\mathcal G_n$. (In general $\beta_n$ is not injective.)

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0CYV (lemma-systems-with-proper-support), remarks (a) and (b) of its first paragraph, which refer to the proof of Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian): cokernels are termwise, and the kernel of alpha has levels K_n = K'_m/I^n K'_m with K'_m the image of Ker(alpha_l) -> F_m for l >= m + c
